next_requirement: Commit the RLS pooled-connection isolation proof as a repeatable test against a real PostgreSQL service container in CI. The mechanism is already proven locally: with a session-level SET, a request carrying NO tenant context read the previous tenant's row on a reused connection; with SET LOCAL inside the transaction it returned zero rows. Then the Next.js 16 upgrade (ADR-0017 step 2), which is independent of every credential blocker.
